name: netfish
description: A Netflix-style front door for a Jellyfin + Seerr + *arr home media stack.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n mock,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run mock -w server" "npm run dev:mock -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
